label: M2.3 frozen PyTorch PPO protocol (KL-anchored constrained PPO from the PyTorch BC policy)

ppo.learner: PyTorch (torch.nn.Module policy + separate critic, autograd, torch.optim.Adam, torch.distributions.Categorical, clip_grad_norm_), float32 on CUDA
ppo.init: every training seed starts from the frozen PyTorch BC checkpoint (identical parameters)
ppo.reference: a frozen deep copy of the BC policy (requires_grad False, never updated)
ppo.critic_init: separate TorchCritic 60 -> 32 tanh -> 1, W1 ~ N(0, 1/sqrt(60)), W2 ~ N(0, 0.01), zero biases, torch generator seed = training seed + 1; policy frozen during the critic warm-up
ppo.development_choice: lr_policy 3e-4 chosen over 1e-4 from the TRAIN-only smokes (draft seed 101, lr3e-4 seed 102): at 1e-4 clipfrac stayed 0 and KL(policy || BC) ~1e-4 (updates too small to test improvement); at 3e-4 KL rose to ~1e-3 with conditional escape, entropy and dual warm-up intact. KL schedule, entropy control, dual warm-up and the 1 : 6 mixture unchanged.

dual.conditional_escape_check: synthetic strong one-sided DNp01 escape probability >= 0.2 and >= 10 x quiet, and threat-trial escape fraction >= 0.5

bc_torch_config.reuses: tools/m2_3_bc_ppo.py BC_CONFIG unchanged (same dataset, NONE subsampling mask, prior correction, learning rate, batch size, epochs, shuffle order, clipping and checkpoint-selection rule)
bc_torch_config.init: parameters copied from MLPPolicyModel(seed = 2303), the numpy BC initialisation
bc_torch_config.loss: torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy on logits + log(0.05) NONE offset (training); natural distribution for TRAIN-VAL selection

bc_config.dataset_train: TRAIN-OPT seeds: 12 threat groups (4 families x 3 attackers) x 50 trials + 4 background families x 30 episodes; seeds drawn by numpy default_rng(2300 + group) from [20e6, 25e6) excluding the M2.1 development seeds
bc_config.dataset_val: the M2.2 TRAIN-VAL specification (96 threat trials, 24 background episodes)
bc_config.teacher: accepted N4B1C FixedEscapePolicy mapped to the 11 maneuvers (game/learning/teacher.py); the mapped maneuver is executed
bc_config.prior_correction: log(1 / none_keep_fraction) added to the NONE logit (training loss uses it, so the learned logits stay calibrated to the natural distribution)
bc_config.checkpoint_selection: epoch with the lowest cross-entropy on the natural-distribution TRAIN-VAL BC set

rollout_inference: per-tick numpy forward on the CPU rollout workers with parameters exported from the torch policy (measured 23.5 us / decision vs 85 us torch-CPU and 642 us torch-CUDA); MaleCNS and the game simulation stay on CPU; the PPO update runs on CUDA
architecture: TorchPolicy 60 -> 32 tanh -> 11 (2,315 trainable parameters) + training-only TorchCritic 60 -> 32 tanh -> 1 (1,985); stochastic seeded sampling at deployment
max_environment_steps: 60 iterations x about 33,000 decisions (7 units x (1 background + 6 threat)); exact counts logged
eligibility: TRAIN-VAL: M2.1 admissible (unnecessary <= 5.36 / min, perches >= 0.275 / min, movement constraints, no hard anti-cheat flag) AND threat-window escape fraction >= 0.3 AND not no_escape-equivalent: synthetic strong one-sided DNp01 escape probability >= 0.2 and >= 10 x quiet, NONE share of TRAIN-VAL background decisions < 0.995 AND measurable neural conditioning on the TRAIN-VAL BC-dataset states: mean escape probability at max DNp01 >= 2 is >= 10 x that at max DNp01 < 0.25
selection: among eligible checkpoints (TRAIN-VAL only): lowest hit probability; then lower unnecessary escapes / min; then smaller mean KL(policy || BC) on the TRAIN-VAL BC-dataset states. Scalar reward is not used.
eval: frozen M2.1 v2 EVAL set, exactly once, for the single selected checkpoint
